name: app.R
demonstration.R
content:
# Test shiny app:
shiny::runApp("proof_of_concept")

# Export with shinylive:
shinylive::export(
  appdir = "proof_of_concept",
  destdir = "proof_of_concept/site",
  subdir = "app1"
)

# Another app:
shinylive::export(
  appdir = "proof_of_concept",
  destdir = "proof_of_concept/site",
  subdir = "app2"
)

# Test:
httpuv::runStaticServer("proof_of_concept/site/app1/", port=8000)
